_doc: Center-screen supercruise / alignment HUD prompts to CV-match (operator-witnessed LIVE, 2026-06-14). These are ED's own center messages that appear during supercruise + SC-assist. Use them as a CV cross-check of the nav-compass for SC-assist alignment, and to detect 'not pointed at the jump/target'. Evidence class: LIVE (Operator provided full frames + crops).

orbiting_destination.color: cyan / light-blue (glyph is a hollow blue triangle above/left of the text)
orbiting_destination.meaning: SC-assist has you orbiting the destination body — arrived / holding at the target. Positive 'we're there' state.
orbiting_destination.seen_in: ARRIVAL > WAIT step (full frame: M7 Sector LN-Z B1-6, orbiting the A belt)
orbiting_destination.match_notes: text is dim white/grey with a cyan triangle; sits just below screen center. Match on the cyan triangle + the literal text 'ORBITING DESTINATION'.

align_with_target_destination.color: orange text + a RED hollow triangle reticle (the 'target is off-screen / behind' marker)
align_with_target_destination.meaning: You are NOT pointed at what you should be. SC-assist wants you to align with the target before it can hold course. The RED triangle also appears when you are not pointed at a jump.
align_with_target_destination.seen_in: SC_RESUME > WAIT step (full frame: Synuefai KL-F B31-0, deep space)
align_with_target_destination.match_notes: orange text 'ALIGN WITH TARGET DESTINATION' with a red triangle; sits above screen center. Slightly higher on screen than ORBITING DESTINATION.

intended_use: CV cross-check of the nav-compass for SC-assist: if 'ALIGN WITH TARGET DESTINATION' is on-screen, the ship is NOT aligned — corroborates / overrides a compass read before trusting SC-assist to hold course.
'ORBITING DESTINATION' = arrived/holding at the destination (a clean arrival signal independent of journal timing).
The RED triangle (align prompt) also signals 'not pointed at a jump' — use to gate jump engagement (fail closed if shown).
Both are center-screen, horizontally centered (~x960), system-independent (fixed cockpit HUD). Vertical: align ~y376, orbiting ~y497.
fixtures: Reference frames operator-provided in chat 2026-06-14 (not yet on disk). Drop the full frames + crops into tests/fixtures/hud/ when captured: orbiting_destination_full.png + orbiting_destination_crop.png, align_with_target_full.png + align_with_target_crop.png.
